A third person held at Delaney Hall, Jose Chajon-Raxon, has now died after ICE released him to a hospital.

ICE says it has no responsibility because he was no longer in custody.

That’s exactly the loophole our bill, the Families Deserve to Know Act, closes. ICE should not be able to release someone and then evade responsibility for what happens to them shortly after.

https://t.co/3JfcNWVdnl

Thank you to Governor Hochul for delivering nearly $10 million for a cath lab at Lincoln Hospital.

I fought for the funding. Governor Hochul delivered for the people of the Bronx.

Russell Vought is wrong.  

187 years before Project 2025, the Supreme Court emphatically rejected Russell Vought’s theory that a president has the constitutional authority to suspend spending laws enacted by Congress.
posts.summary: Rejects Vought's theory of presidential spending authority as unconstitutional
posts.quote:
Russell Vought is wrong.  

187 years before Project 2025, the Supreme Court emphatically rejected Russell Vought’s theory that a president has the constitutional authority to suspend spending laws enacted by Congress.

posts.text:
Russell Vought has repeatedly asserted that Donald Trump has the power to suspend spending laws enacted by Congress.

I asked Mr. Vought whether, under his theory, the President could unilaterally defund the DOD, the Supreme Court, Social Security, and Medicare. 

He refused to answer.
posts.summary: Questions Vought's claim that president can unilaterally defund federal programs
posts.quote:
Russell Vought has repeatedly asserted that Donald Trump has the power to suspend spending laws enacted by Congress.

I asked Mr. Vought whether, under his theory, the President could unilaterally defund the DOD, the Supreme Court, Social Security, and Medicare. 

He refused to answer.

Lower energy costs. Cleaner air. A greener Bronx.

posts.text:
There is no contradiction between July 4th and Juneteenth. All Americans should take pride in both.

July 4th celebrates the founding promise of equality and liberty for all.

Juneteenth celebrates the enforcement of our founding promise.

Both are chapters in the ever-unfolding American Revolution.
posts.summary: Frames July 4th and Juneteenth as complementary American ideals

Donald Trump ran for President promising to drain the swamp.  Instead, he became the swamp.  

The acceptance of a $400 million Qatari Air Force One has revealed his presidency for what it is and has always been: a cesspool of corruption.
posts.summary: Accuses Trump of embodying the swamp, cites Qatar jet gift as corruption
posts.quote:
Donald Trump ran for President promising to drain the swamp.  Instead, he became the swamp.  

The acceptance of a $400 million Qatari Air Force One has revealed his presidency for what it is and has always been: a cesspool of corruption.

posts.text:
The greatest scandal is not that Donald Trump is failing to avoid the appearance of corruption. The greatest scandal is that he is not even trying.

His acceptance of a $400 million luxury jet from Qatar—a “palace in the sky”—is the latest chapter in the unfolding story of a corrupt presidency.
posts.summary: Condemns Trump's acceptance of Qatari luxury jet as corrupt presidency

The greatest scandal is not that Donald Trump is failing to avoid the appearance of corruption. The greatest scandal is that he is not even trying.
